summer.prompt: Redraw this image from scratch as beautiful handcrafted 16-bit pixel art for a polished atmospheric 2D platformer. Use clearly visible deliberate square pixel clusters, a restrained harmonious palette, stepped silhouettes, sparing hand-placed dithering, no smooth gradients, no photography, no painterly brush strokes, no outlines around every object. Think a lovingly authored 320x180-pixel landscape enlarged with perfectly crisp nearest-neighbor edges, broad readable shapes and carefully chosen highlights. Retain the seasonal setting and approximate composition, but simplify small detail substantially into intentional pixel shapes. The result should feel warm, adventurous and artistic, between charming and grounded; not photorealistic, not childish. Keep the landscape full-frame 16:9, no text, no frame, no interface, no characters or collision platforms.
summer.method: Redraw of a generated naturalistic reference
